couplets.en: What ails you, my foolish heart?

lines: Aakhir is dard ki dawa kya hai?
couplets.en: What, after all, can ease this ache?

lines: Hum ko un se wafa ki hai ummeed
couplets.en: I still hope they will be true.

lines: Jo nahin jaante wafa kya hai
couplets.en: They have never known what it means to be true.
What ails you, my foolish heart?

lines: Aakhir is dard ki dawa kya hai?
couplets.en: What, after all, can ease this ache?

lines: Hum hain mushtaaq aur woh bezaar
couplets.en: I long for them, and they have grown weary of me.

lines: Ya Ilaahi, yeh maajra kya hai?
couplets.en: My God, what am I to make of this?

lines: Jab ki tujh bin nahin koi maujood
couplets.en: There is no one here but you.

lines: Phir yeh hangaama, ai Khuda, kya hai?
couplets.en: Then what is all this tumult, my God?
What ails you, my foolish heart?

lines: Jaan tum par nisaar karta hoon
couplets.en: I lay down my life for you.

lines: Main nahin jaanta dua kya hai
couplets.en: I do not know what it is to pray.
What ails you, my foolish heart?
What ails you, my foolish heart?
